rec.name: PDP Product Comparison Chart (Metaobject-driven)
rec.status: Built — launched (reusable setup guide delivered; documented in Slite)

what.text: A theme-editor block on the product page that shows a side-by-side comparison of two products. It has a centered title and subtitle, then a table. The left column holds row labels (e.g. product group, availability, mechanism of action, target use, long-term effect, purchase conditions). The right side shows two product columns on a grey background, each with a product image, a bold product name and one value per row. On mobile the product columns scroll horizontally.

why.text: A comparison chart helps visitors who are unsure which variant or product fits them. It cuts decision effort and choice overload, and it answers pre-purchase questions on the page so shoppers don't leave to look elsewhere. Putting the current product next to a close alternative also supports cross-selling and reduces wrong-product purchases and returns. Consistent row labels make differences easy to scan.

how.text: 1) Duplicate the theme first. 2) Create the metaobject definition 'CRO | PDP | Compare chart' (type cro_pdp_compare_chart) with fields: name (display name, required), title, content, chart_heading_list (list of single-line text), product_01/02 image (file), product_01/02 heading, and product_01/02 content list (list of single-line text). 3) Create a product metafield 'CRO | PDP | Compare chart' (namespace/key standard.cro_pdp_compare_chart), type Mixed reference, pointing to the metaobject. If Mixed reference is unavailable, use a Reference to the metaobject instead. 4) Add the schema block 'cro_compare_chart' (limit 1) to sections/main-product.liquid. 5) Create the snippet ed-cro-pdp-compare-chart.liquid, which renders the header, the heading column and a two-column product grid. The table is a 2-column grid (144px label column, 120px on mobile) and the product columns scroll horizontally at 70% width (85% on mobile). 6) In the product form snippet, loop over section.blocks and render the snippet for the 'cro_compare_chart' block type. 7) Assign the metaobject entry to each product via its metafield, then test on the duplicate theme before publishing. The block only renders when the product metafield is set.

items: Content (via metaobject): title, subtitle, row-label list, and for each of 2 products an image, heading and list of row values

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with a product section that supports blocks (e.g. main-product.liquid) and a product form snippet. Requires the metaobject definition 'CRO | PDP | Compare chart' and the product metafield standard.cro_pdp_compare_chart (Mixed reference, or Reference as a fallback). Each product needs a metaobject entry assigned. Rows of the two products must line up with the shared heading list. The snippet is hard-coded for exactly 2 products. No app required. Developer-oriented install, so the setup guide was rewritten for non-developers.

items: Click-through to the alternative product (if linked)
Scroll depth and engagement with the chart (horizontal scroll on mobile)
